rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A slide's BODY is size-bounded, not just its header (§4's sibling).
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/exercises/apt101-build-your-product-memory.md -> 9 slides, oversized: 0, exit=0 (exercise slides count; prompt includes excluded)

Harm prevented: a flattened or prematurely resolved mood stealing the next beat. Absent here. L97 'The memory sits still until something reads it. Next, each of you gives it a job.' leaves the student proud of one sharp page, honest about one soft page, wanting to give it a job. Trace phases 2-6 mood 8, close 8. Closest to the floor: L59 'If yes, it's soft. That list is your first quality check.' stays 8 because the sting is about the page, not the person. L1-14 opening and plan-mode/ingest plumbing are setup beats, mood-exempt, clear and brief.

L59 'Could a competitor's memory carry this top claim? If yes, it's soft.' and L71 'A claim the agent cut is a decision you should see.' Unease is about the page's sharpness (not-knowing), never about having done wrong; nothing shames the student. Closest: L71 'Push back if a claim "got sharper" but the top didn't change' targets Claude's report, not the student.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Lead with discipline, not failure mode.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Headers L15 'Phase 1: Curate, ingest, build', L61 'Phase 3: Make it sharper, not longer' lead with discipline. Closest to a failure word: L51 'Phase 2: Find the soft pages', a negative case that serves the sharpening discipline, not a title-level failure lead; L7 'A chat forgets. A memory remembers.' is contrast framing.

Facets: front-run: body names nothing from Day 2 (grep 'Day 2|overnight|digest|Module|M[0-9]' above fence -> 0; Day 2 appears only at L104,112 in the maintainer block). Module-to-module arc: L97 'Next, each of you gives it a job.' hands to apt101-send-it-off (agent reads the memory), matching maintainer Role. Big Idea (strategy doc 'transfer: what you know goes in before the run', 'the team's material is the moat'): L9 'Three memories, one bet, three seats' and L13 door line honour it. Mood does not resolve early: Phase 5 L87 'don't settle it yet' leaves the customer disagreement open, and the memory is not verified as true here, so Day 2's fluent-digest unease is not pre-empted. 'agents/' folder named at L11 as empty, no agent taught.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Classroom = default delivery; body teaches work, trainer manages room.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L87 'Laptops half shut. Each of you reads out the top claim of your strongest page, and one soft page. ... Where they disagree about the customer, say so out loud, and don't settle it yet.' Phase 5 authors a room round with a prescribed utterance. The second carve-out (mode-defining cue on a sanctioned human slot) may cover the mode switch, but needs a dated maintainer accept-note and a cue of one clause; the maintainer block (L99-120, only dated line L101 Quality) has no accept-note ('Role moves' L112 describes Phase 5 without naming the carve-out) and the cue prescribes form (what each reads out, how to treat disagreement). Harm the rule prevents: body doing cohort management the trainer owns. Present only mildly: L114 gives the trainer the stop, and the round is the designed human close about the work.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Add a maintainer accept-note naming the sanctioned-human-slot carve-out and cut L87 to the mode clause, or record the Phase 5 shape as an APT101-wide decision.
